packageRules.description: Merge non-major updates once every check is green
cargo-dist: bump .mise.toml and dist-workspace.toml together; release.yml must be regenerated by hand
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ Run `mise install && mise x -- dist generate` on this branch and commit `.github/workflows/release.yml` before merging. Renovate ignores that file, and an outdated one breaks the release.
